title: Skinny cans? No.
text: Skinny cans? No.. So why are there pictures of skinny cans in this koozie??? I feel like I was duped by this company that this was universal to regular and skinny cans. It’s SO not. White Claw-size cans are way too skinny and there’s way too much space between the koozie and can to hold it in place and it’s not possible to keep it that cool with so much space in between. I thought there’s was some set of adapter to convert it to skinny compatible but there is not. Works great for standard beer cans and tall boys, also I like the cocktail feature. Skinny cans, you’ll have to buy another koozie.
